description: The first fortnight is solidarity. By the second month the host family's own tolerance, money and space are gone, and nobody can say so out loud because of what is happening outside.
energy_note: A welcome you can feel expiring.

aspect: Children in a household that is not theirs
description: Different rules, no room, someone else's parents, and an instruction to be good because the family is a guest. Children respond with regression - bedwetting, clinging, silence - which the adults read as bad behaviour.
energy_note: Told to be perfect while the world is not.
notes: Regression under war stress is documented: 27% bedwetting reported by parents in Gaza during the Second Intifada, three quarters of children in the 2022 Save the Children survey.

aspect: No registration means no help and no record
description: Aid, compensation and later reparations follow lists. People who sheltered with relatives are on no list, so when anything is eventually distributed they are not eligible and cannot prove they were displaced at all.
money_note: Compensation never received because never registered.
energy_note: Displaced without being counted as displaced.

description: Four adults and three children in a two-bedroom flat in Mashhad. He sleeps in the hallway. He has a job interview and no address he is willing to give.
energy_note: Employed nowhere, living in a corridor.
